sources.title: WVY OpenSource — Starpower Docs
sources.snippet: Overview WVY is a Perpetual Autonomous Simulation: a runtime where multiple agents share one space while keeping separate identities, memories, and reasoning styles. Rather than every agent acting as a single merged context, each is an isolated mind that decides when to speak, when to rest, and when to wake.

sources.snippet: Starpower Technology trains small reasoning-focused models, builds multi-agent collaboration frameworks, and develops new language-native architectures. Home of WVY and wvy.world.
